outcome.technical: stamp-verification.py: added playwright JSON-reporter (--reporter=json) and line/list-reporter reading (_json_blob, playwright_json_cases/_tally, playwright_line_cases/_tally, playwright_cases), vitest's JSON reporter (jest-compatible schema: vitest_json_cases/_tally), wired through new red_read_tally/red_failing_cases wrappers used by classify_run, baseline_problem, fix_problem and red_verdict in place of the raw _runner_output.read_tally/failing_cases calls those three used before (which returned None/[] for both reporters, since _runner_output.py carries no row for either - out of this task's files scope, so the reporters are read locally rather than by widening that module). Added JS_RUNNERS += 'playwright' and widened js_test_cases' scope-opening check so a chained call ending in '.describe' (playwright's own 'test.describe(...)' nesting) opens a describe scope the same way jest's bare 'describe(...)' does, which is what lets a playwright spec's failing case be credited to a declared test file through the existing jest/vitest crediting machinery (case_site, _js_credit_problem) with no new crediting logic. Added a local _PW_LINE_ENTRY regex for playwright's line reporter instead of reusing _runner_output._FAILURE_READERS['playwright'], whose stored pattern lacks re.M and so never matches more than a single-line input (a latent bug in a file outside this task's scope, not touched). Added an 'export' row to MISSING_SPELLINGS reading node's/vite's "The requested module '<spec>' does not provide an export named '<name>'" wording, matched in missing_subjects by the export name directly (report_module now requires 'importer' before resolving a module-file report, so an export-only report falls through to None there rather than KeyError-ing on a missing key) - this is the --introduces evidence path the danuvia testbed's three unread import errors needed. tests/test_stamp_verification.py: 7 new cases (se1, se2, sm-export-missing stage; sp1, sp2, sr-playwright stage; sv-json1, sv-json2, sr-vitest-json stage; scs1, sr-could-not-start stage), each written and run red against the pre-fix code (classify_run returned no-tally/collection-error for playwright and vitest-json text, and case-credit failed on the test.describe nesting) before the implementation above turned them green. Full suite: python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_stamp_verification.py --selftest -> ALL PASS: 273/273 cases passed. Full tree sweep: python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py -> 332/332 files ok, 152 migrated to tests/, 15918 cases.
outcome.descriptive: Red-first proofs now read Playwright's and vitest's JSON and line reporters, and a JS 'export not found' error naming an introduced symbol, closing three of the causes measured on the danuvia testbed (1 of 134 tasks proved).
